title: Late-Fee History and FlexLine Replacement Relief
content:
FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit — the late-history share for replacement relief follows the late-fee entries on the line in the last 12 months: exactly one gives 0.80; two or more give 0.50; none gives 1.00.

The share multiplies the replacement relief as figured from the fee, before it is rounded to the cent. The last 12 months take the late-fee entries dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the relief date.

## Questions answered

**One late-fee entry eight months before the relief date?** 0.80.

**Two late-fee entries, both within the window?** 0.50.

**A single late-fee entry dated on the same day of the month 12 months before the relief date?** Outside the window: 1.00.
